cardEffects:
By placing 10 Tamer cards and/or cards with the [Hybrid] trait from your hand and/or trash at the bottom of your deck in any order, you may digivolve this card from your hand onto one of your Tamers as if the Tamer is a level 6 Digimon.
＜Security A. +2＞ (This Digimon checks 2 additional security cards.)
[When Digivolving] Delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon.
name: Susanoomon

rulings.answer: This card’s digivolution requirement icon refers to all colors.  Currently, this Digimon can digivolve onto a level 6 Digimon that’s red, blue, yellow, green, black, purple, or white.
rulings.question: What color cards does this card’s digivolution requirement icon refer to?

rulings.answer: No, you can mix and match cards from your hand and trash. As long as you return a total of 10 cards to the bottom of your deck, you can activate the effect.
rulings.question: This card’s effect reads, “10 Tamer cards and/or cards with [Hybrid] in their traits from your hand and/or trash,” but does this mean I can only activate the effect by returning 10 cards in my hand or 10 cards in my trash?

rulings.answer: No. A Tamer card's [Security] effect isn't an inherited effect.  Some Tamer cards do have inherited effects, and those can be activated when such cards are placed in digivolution cards.
rulings.question: If this card has a Tamer card in its digivolution cards, does that Tamer card’s [Security] effect become an inherited effect?
Instead of a Tamer card, can I digivolve this card onto a level 6 Digimon that meets the digivolution requirements?

rulings.answer: es, it is. However, if the effect specifies that it trashes Digimon cards, Digi-Egg cards, or any other type of card that isn't a Tamer card, it can't affect Tamer cards.
rulings.question: After a Tamer card ends up in this Digimon's digivolution cards, is that card affected by effects that trash digivolution cards?

rulings.answer: Yes, you do. Even if you digivolve onto a Tamer card, make sure to draw 1 card as the digivolution bonus.
rulings.question: If I digivolve this card on top of a Tamer card, do I still get the digivolution bonus?

rulings.answer: Yes. Digivolution doesn't count as “playing” a card, so you can attack that turn.
rulings.question: Can I attack the turn I digivolve this card on top of a Tamer card?

rulings.answer: No. Since it's the first turn the Tamer was played, the limitation for attacking on the first turn a card is played still applies.
rulings.question: I play a Tamer card, then digivolve it into this Digimon. Can I then attack with this Digimon during that same turn?
If I've digivolved this card on top of a Tamer card and the Digimon is deleted, what happens to the Tamer card?

rulings.answer: No, you must reveal this card from your hand in advance.  You must perform the “placing 10 Tamer cards and/or cards with [Hybrid] in their traits from your hand and/or trash at the bottom of your deck” part of the effect before the digivolution takes place, so you must reveal the card from your hand first.
rulings.question: Can I activate this card’s “placing 10 Tamer cards and/or cards with [Hybrid] in their traits from your hand and/or trash at the bottom of your deck” effect while this card is still in my hand?

rulings.answer: Yes. The effect reads, “You may digivolve,” so you can choose not to.  If you choose not to digivolve, this card is trashed after you reveal it.  Note that the game will not view this as you trashing a card in your hand.
rulings.question: Can I activate this card’s “placing 10 Tamer cards and/or cards with [Hybrid] in their traits from your hand and/or trash at the bottom of your deck” effect but choose not to digivolve this card?

rulings.answer: Yes, you can.  In this case, you can’t digivolve even after performing the actions described by the effect. After revealing this card, it is trashed.  Note that the game will not view this as you trashing a card in your hand.
rulings.question: Can I activate this card’s “placing 10 Tamer cards and/or cards with [Hybrid] in their traits from your hand and/or trash at the bottom of your deck” effect when I have no Tamers in play?
Can I digivolve one of my Tamers in the battle area into this card in the hand when an effect to digivolve one of my Digimon is activated?
